name: Pre-PR surface check - measure what a branch actually proposes
description: Blueprint 88 of 96 (design BP-REL-02). Before `gh pr create`, MEASURE the commit-to-commit surface with three dots so a stale branch cannot propose deleting everything the base has gained. Mechanism: a purely deterministic git measurement plus a deletion-ratio verdict - there is no model in the measurement path, which is why this workflow declares no model_routing and no artifact cache (a cached surface measurement certifies a stale branch tip).

branch.description: The branch whose proposed surface is being measured (its tip, not the working tree)

base.description: The base ref the PR would target. Must be fetched: a stale local base makes every number wrong.

repo_root.description: ABSOLUTE repo root. A repo-relative default dies with [Errno 2] from any other cwd.

deletion_ratio_stop.description: Deletions / (insertions + deletions) at or above which the verdict is STOP rather than REVIEW

credential_name_patterns.description: Untracked-file globs that must be surfaced even though they are NOT in the PR - the two-dot diff is what makes them look like they are

surface-auditor.description: Runs the git measurement and emits the verdict. Mechanical: it reports numbers, it does not judge semantic appropriateness.

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that may accept a STOP verdict and open the PR anyway

deletion-ratio-verdict.expression: verdict == SAFE OR verdict == REVIEW OR cherry_pick_alternative_proposed == true

work_unit.title: Measure the commit-to-commit surface of the branch against the base
work_unit.question_or_target: Run `git diff <base>...HEAD --stat` (THREE dots) plus `git diff --name-status <merge-base> <tip>` and record files_changed, insertions, deletions, and the A/M/D composition. Resolve and record the merge-base SHA.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a byte/line comparison is answerable by an exact algorithm, so it is not handed to a model (fan-out-contract C4: LLM judgement on a mechanical comparison measured 86% accurate with 100% of errors pointing at data loss)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the literal git command line AND its raw stdout for both the three-dot stat and the name-status composition; a summary without the command line is not evidence
tests_required: both-states control: on a branch 300 commits behind the base the run must report a deletion-heavy surface, and on a rebased copy of the SAME branch it must not
the two-dot form must be shown to differ from the three-dot form on at least one fixture, otherwise the three-dot requirement is decorative
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - the output is a raw measurement; the reviewer requirement attaches to the verdict stage, not to the numbers
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8801 emitted only when the merge-base SHA is recorded and both raw command outputs are captured; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8801 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a git measurement that fails twice is an environment fault, not a flake

stages.title: A wrong base makes every number wrong
Three dots mandatory - two dots folds in working-tree noise

work_unit.title: Compute the deletion ratio and split additions from modifications
work_unit.question_or_target: From the recorded measurement compute deletion_ratio = deletions / (insertions + deletions), and split the name-status composition into A (added, never conflicts), M (modified, the real reconcile surface) and D (deleted). Report the M-count as the conflict surface, NOT the line count.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: the arithmetic shown with its inputs, plus the A/M/D counts from the name-status output; a ratio with no numerator and denominator is not checkable
tests_required: an all-additions branch must yield deletion_ratio 0 and an M-count of 0
a branch whose only change is a rename must not be counted as a deletion plus an addition
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - arithmetic is re-derivable from the recorded inputs
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8802 emitted only when deletion_ratio and the A/M/D split are both present; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8802 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - arithmetic over a recorded input is deterministic; a second attempt would produce the same number

stages.title: Files a two-dot diff would have folded in

work_unit.title: Enumerate untracked and unstaged paths, flagging credential-shaped names
work_unit.question_or_target: Run `git status --porcelain -uall` (collapsed untracked directories hide members) and list every untracked or unstaged path, marking those matching credential_name_patterns. State explicitly that these are NOT in the PR - the point is that they are on disk.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: set membership against a glob list

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the porcelain output with -uall, and for each flagged path its name only - never its contents, never a value
tests_required: a credential-shaped file inside an untracked DIRECTORY must be listed: `git status --porcelain` without -uall collapses the directory and the member is invisible
no flagged path's contents may appear anywhere in the artifact
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none for the enumeration; any flagged path is reported to the owner, who decides
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8803 emitted only when -uall was used and every flagged path carries a name-only record; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8803 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a truncated enumeration is a detector fault, so re-running the same truncating command is banned by AGENTS.md 4b

stages.title: SAFE / REVIEW / STOP with the numbers that produced it

work_unit.title: Emit the surface verdict and, when STOP, the cherry-pick-onto-fresh-base alternative
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit verdict SAFE | REVIEW | STOP. STOP when deletion_ratio >= deletion_ratio_stop. On STOP, propose the concrete alternative: cherry-pick the wanted commits onto a fresh branch cut from the fetched base, and state the surface that alternative would produce.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the THRESHOLD comparison is mechanical, but naming which commits to cherry-pick is judgement; only that half is modelled

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verdict plus every number it rests on inline, plus the threshold it was compared against; a bare verdict is a claim, not a measurement
tests_required: a deletion-heavy surface must produce STOP, not a warning
a clean branch must produce SAFE and the artifact must still carry the numbers
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader who re-derives the verdict from the recorded numbers without re-running git
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8804 emitted only when the verdict, its numbers, and (on STOP) the cherry-pick alternative are all present; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8804 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a verdict that needs a retry means an input was missing, which is a FAILED terminal state

stages.title: STOP is a stop, not a warning

estimate.measurement_source: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md#BP-REL-02 - the recorded incident where a leftover feature branch showed 1,188 files / 316,222 deletions against main and the cherry-pick-onto-fresh-base alternative reduced it to 7 files / 4 deletions

impact.blast_radius: reads git, writes only under command-center/release/**; no ref is created, moved or deleted

derived_from.credit: owner - the three-dot rule and the -uall collapse

x_extensions.mechanism: deterministic three-dot commit-to-commit measurement + deletion-ratio threshold verdict. No agent judgement in the measurement path; the only modelled step is naming the cherry-pick alternative.

not_a_duplicate_because.vs_pr-shepherd-to-merge: that drives an ALREADY-OPEN PR to merge by decoding CI status; this runs BEFORE the PR exists and never touches CI
not_a_duplicate_because.vs_live-to-repo-drift-reconcile: that compares two TREES on disk; this compares two COMMITS and never writes into either tree
not_a_duplicate_because.vs_dual-tree-plumbing-mirror: that mirrors blobs; this writes no blob anywhere

contraindications: none - it is cheap enough to always run before `gh pr create`

benchmark_cases.given: a branch 300 commits behind the fetched base
benchmark_cases.expect: verdict STOP with the deletion count named, plus a cherry-pick alternative

benchmark_cases.given: a repo with uncommitted working-tree changes AND a branch behind the base
benchmark_cases.expect: the two-dot and three-dot surfaces DIFFER, and the recorded diff_mode is THREE_DOT

benchmark_cases.given: an untracked directory containing a *.pem file
benchmark_cases.expect: the .pem is listed by name (proving -uall was used) and its contents appear nowhere

worked_examples.alternative_proposed: cherry-pick 1 commit onto a fresh branch cut from origin/main
worked_examples.terminal_state: SUCCESS:BPW-8804 - verdict STOP with numbers and alternative attached
worked_examples.note: The numbers in this example are the ones recorded in the design card; they are the reason the threshold defaults to 0.25 rather than to a round number chosen by taste.

unverified: The 0.25 default threshold is a JUDGEMENT, not a measurement: the recorded incident sat at 0.987 and a clean branch at 0.033, so any threshold between them would have separated those two cases. Settling experiment = run the check over the last 50 merged PRs in this estate and pick the threshold that produces zero STOP verdicts on PRs that merged cleanly.
